name: @authoryx/workspace
description: Agent tools for Authoryx: an agent asks for a secret, the secret's owner decides, and the value goes to a program, not to the conversation.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @authoryx/sdk && npm run build -w @authoryx/core && npm run build -w authoryx && npm run build -w @authoryx/mcp
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check
